wire.settings.keymap.new_session.label: New session
wire.settings.keymap.new_session.help: Starts a fresh conversation, the same as /new.
wire.settings.keymap.resume.label: Resume a session
wire.settings.keymap.resume.help: Opens the picker of recent conversations, the same as /resume.
wire.settings.keymap.quick_send.label: Quick send
wire.settings.keymap.quick_send.help: Opens a small composer over other apps; messages the chief of staff.
wire.settings.keymap.push_to_talk.label: Push to talk
wire.settings.keymap.push_to_talk.help: Hold to dictate (desktop); release to stop.
wire.settings.keymap.start_recording.hel: Starts speech-to-text recording in the desktop window.
wire.settings.keymap.command_palette.hel: Searches every command, setting and conversation from one box.
wire.settings.keymap.toggle_sidebar.help: Shows or hides the session sidebar; /sidebar does the same.
wire.settings.keymap.focus_sidebar.label: Focus sessions
wire.settings.keymap.focus_sidebar.help: Moves the keys into the sessions list; esc returns to the composer.
wire.settings.keymap.aside.label: Aside
wire.settings.keymap.aside.help: Asks a side question without spending the composer's draft.
wire.settings.keymap.fork_aside.label: Fork aside
wire.settings.keymap.fork_aside.help: Promotes the open aside exchange into the conversation.
wire.settings.keymap.toggle_todos.label: Todo panel
wire.settings.keymap.toggle_todos.help: Expands or collapses the dock's todo list.
wire.settings.keymap.toggle_subagents.he: Cycles the dock's subagent panel: full, summary, hidden.
wire.settings.keymap.toggle_pin.label: Pin session
wire.settings.keymap.toggle_pin.help: Pins or unpins the row under the pointer, else the sidebar's cursor.
wire.settings.keymap.toggle_asks.label: Queued asks
wire.settings.keymap.toggle_asks.help: Opens or collapses the questions waiting on an answer.
wire.settings.keymap.prev_session.label: Previous session
wire.settings.keymap.prev_session.help: Switches to the previous conversation in the sidebar.
wire.settings.keymap.next_session.label: Next session
wire.settings.keymap.next_session.help: Switches to the next conversation in the sidebar.
wire.settings.keymap.cycle_effort.label: Reasoning effort
wire.settings.keymap.cycle_effort.help: Cycles the reasoning effort level; /effort sets one directly.
wire.settings.keymap.clear_transcript.he: Clears the transcript view; the stored history stays.
wire.settings.keymap.transcript_up.label: Scroll transcript up
wire.settings.keymap.transcript_up.help: Scrolls the conversation up two rows; the caret stays in the composer.
wire.settings.keymap.transcript_down.hel: Scrolls the conversation down two rows; the caret stays in the composer.
Scrolls the conversation up half a screen; the caret stays in the composer.
wire.settings.keymap.transcript_half_dow: Scrolls the conversation down half a screen; the caret stays in the composer.
